notes.title: The new translated version will be released soon！
notes.notes:
Based on feedback from some players, we know that there are many problems with the English and Japanese versions. 

Due to our short development cycle and few staff, please forgive us for speeding up the process and using machine translation.


We will contact the professional translation team as soon as possible to update the new version.

Thank players for playing our game and for their comments!
